description: The live fold (CPD-6, CPD6-4): live layers meet into one answer whatever their order and however often one repeats, and pin ⊓ live only narrows. `values` is what live_fold holds per dimension path; `bottom` lists the paths whose meet is empty (two unrelated values), which no later layer lifts and which pin ⊓ live leaves absent. Python's harness_core.policy is the only live fold (Node meets nothing live); read by backend/python/tests/unit/harness_core/policy/test_live_fold.py.

cases.behaviour: two unrelated modes meet to the bottom; a third layer repeating one of them does not lift it (CPD6-4)
a mode below another is their meet
numeric ceilings take the minimum; unrelated dimensions do not interact
the kill switch, once on in any live layer, stays on
